ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOFGROUNDLEASE(COMMERCIALUNIT) THIS ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION OF GROUND LEASE AGREEMENT (COMMERCIAL UNIT) (this “Assignment"), made and entered into this 31st day of March, 2022, MOYNIHAN INTERIM TENANT LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an office at c/o Vornado Realty Trust, 888 Seventh Avenue, New York, New York 10019, ("Assignor"), in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.o0) and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, hereby assigns, transfers and conveys to MOYNIHAN COMMERCIAL MASTER LANDLORD SPE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Vornado Realty Trust, 888 Seventh Avenue, New York, New York 10019 ("Assignee"), all right, title and interest of Assignor as tenant under that certain Amended and Restated Agreement of Lease (Commercial Unit) (as amended, the “Ground Lease"), made by and between New York State Urban Development Corporation d/b/a Empire State Development, as landlord, and Assignor, as tenant, dated as of December 31, 2020, an Amendment to Memorandum of Amended and Restated Agreement of Lease (Commercial Unit) of which, dated as of December 31, 2020, was recorded on January 29, 2021 as CRFN 2021000036054, in effect with respect to the Commercial Unit in the condominium known as "The James A. Farley Condominium" (the “Condominium"), which Condominium is evidenced by that certain Declaration of The James A. Farley Condominium (the “Condominium Declaration") which was recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York on December24,2020asCRFN2020000367800. TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the same unto Assignee, its successors and assigns, forever, from and after the date hereof, subject to the terms, covenants, conditions and provisions of the Ground Lease. ASSIGNEE HEREBY ACCEPTS the foregoing assignment, assumes and agrees, from and after the date hereof, to perform all of the obligations of tenant under the Ground Lease and agrees to be bound by all of the covenants, agreements, terms, provisions and conditions of the Ground Lease on the part of the tenant to be performed or observed; and  This Assignment is made without any covenant, warranty or representation by, or recourse against, Assignor of any kind whatsoever. This Assignment may not be amended, modified or terminated except by an instrument in writingexecuted by the partieshereto. This Assignment shall be binding upon and shall inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective successors and/or permitted assigns. This Assignment may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall constitute an original, and all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same instrument. This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed wholly in the State of New York.
